name: Context Menu UI
description: Floating right-click context menu. Positioned at mouse coordinates. Items with labels and click actions, separators, and disabled items. Singleton behavior: opening a new menu closes any existing ones. Closes on outside click.

dom.root: .ctx-menu (position: fixed, left: x px, top: y px, z-index: 10001, background: var(--surface), border: 1px solid var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 4px 0, min-width: 160px, box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))

elements.ctx-item: .ctx-item (padding: 6px 16px, cursor: pointer, font-size: 13px, color: var(--primary), font-family: 'Space Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; hover: background var(--panel))

interactions.name: select_item
interactions.result: Menu removed from DOM, action executed, onClose fired

interactions.name: close_outside
interactions.action: this.remove() → Remove document click listener → Fire onClose
interactions.propagation: document click listener added via setTimeout(0) to avoid immediate self-close from the triggering click

interactions.name: close_existing
interactions.trigger: ContextMenu constructor called while another menu exists
interactions.action: Loop ContextMenu.openMenus → call remove() on each → Clear array before creating new menu
interactions.result: Only one context menu visible at a time

states.open: Menu visible at (x, y), items rendered with labels and separators, document click listener active
states.closed: Menu removed from DOM, static openMenus tracking cleaned, onClose fired

dynamic_content.items: Each ContextMenuItem renders as .ctx-item with label textContent and optional click handler. separator:true renders .ctx-sep with no click handler. disabled:true adds .ctx-disabled class and skips click binding.
